property_summary: For every call to transfer(from, caddress, _tos, v), if _tos is empty the reference C reverts (requires non-empty array) while the mutant allows the call to succeed; thus the invariant is that transfer always reverts when given an empty _tos array — the mutant violates this by returning true instead.
change_summary: Change the required condition to allow empty _tos arrays (remove require), so transfer no longer reverts when _tos.length == 0.
